name: Friends School of Portland Summer Camp
description_short: Nature and arts day camp at Friends School of Portland, a Quaker school in Cumberland Foreside, Maine: Chickadee (ages 4-5), Fox (6-8) and Crow (9-11) groups plus a Counselor in Training program for 12-14. Weeks run Monday to Friday, 8:30 am to 3 pm; Crow Camp is outdoors all day and ends with a camping adventure week.
